judgements.reason: Trigger landed_this_week but the prediction's own landing window is Q1 2027 (target_start 2027-01-01), not closing this week, so the 'did landing come true' test is premature. The thesis (>=3 agent frameworks ship read-only/SELECT-only default SQL execution) remains forward-valid and is gaining support: Flowise 3.1.0 default allowlist guard (bridge 0f791386, so_that), Databricks Unity AI Gateway contextual SQL policy as a default (e90ec8d3, given), and June 27 Langflow IDOR/AutoGPT SSRF CVEs reinforcing the deny-by-default root cause (d2dae7b1, because). Bridges themselves note the controls are still broad MCP/tool-execution rather than the specific parser-level read-only SQL default the prediction names, so the landing is not yet met. Reasoning because/given/so_that/landing all hold; no reframe needed.

Four recent bridges (latest 2026-06-27, observed_relevance 3-4) are coherent, correctly scoped, and span because/given/so_that dimensions. They honestly distinguish directionally-aligned platform/MCP controls from the precise parser-enforced read-only SQL default the prediction targets. No contradict signals, no stale or duplicate bridges to retire.

All three Needs (SQL-tool maintainer ships SELECT-only default, docs maintainer elevates read-only creds to prerequisite, security researcher replays injection-to-RCE and files critical CVEs) remain forward-looking and unmet. No bridge documents a framework shipping the specific read-only SQL default that would flip a Need to done; the broad MCP guards (Flowise) are adjacent, not the named deliverable. Actor coalition unchanged.

No chain or relation edges touch this prediction (no source/target edges found), and no upstream landing or contradiction this week alters the chain. Landing window stays Q1 2027; nothing to shorten or add.
